outline:
學生與教授討論，擬定研究題目，在教授個別指導下，進行實驗研究，以培養學生尋找相關文獻資料及獨立研究的能力，並將其研究成果撰寫成報告，公開口頭發表研究成果。
The aim of the course is to cultivate the students' ability to conduct independent studies.  Each student will be assigned a research topic and perform experimental work under the guidance of an advisor.  Each student will have to prepare a final report and deliver an oral presentation at the end of the course.
schedule:
Weekly experimental work
Biweekly meeting and report
